name: Turbine 15m BTC favourite
source: turbinefi.com backtest parameters, read 2026-09-10. Reported 93% win rate, Sharpe 1.72.
notes: The published rules also carry stop losses (sell all at a 0.55 yes bid, or a 0.95 yes bid against a NO position). Those need the price path AFTER entry and are NOT scored here — the spec parser rejects an exit it cannot model rather than ignoring it, so this audits the hold-to-settlement version and says so. The entry signal 'edge BTC 15m > 0' is a black box we cannot reproduce, so this measures the strategy WITHOUT it: what the filters alone select.
